//! The Canvas permission registry.
//!
//! Every permission Canvas declares, with the rules that decide who holds
//! it. The data is transcribed from the running Canvas:
//! `migration/parity/canvas-api-surface.json` (the dump written by
//! `canvas-boot/canvas_introspection.rb`) for `true_for` / `false_for` /
//! `account_only` / `deprecated` / `not_for_masquerading`, and
//! `canvas-src/config/initializers/permissions_registry.rb` for
//! `available_to` / `applies_to_concluded` / `account_allows` /
//! `restrict_future_enrollments`.
//!
//! GENERATED — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with
//! `migration/tools/parity/gen_permission_registry.py`.
//!
//! The rules themselves live in [`crate::rules`].

use crate::rules::{Concluded, RoleKind};

/// Where a permission may be administered, and whether it may only be
/// administered at the root account or by a site admin.
///
/// Mirrors `account_only` in the Ruby registry. `Account` is the registry's
/// `account_only: true`, which only restricts the permission *management*
/// UI and does not change the grant.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AccountOnly {
    /// No account restriction.
    None,
    /// `account_only: true` — manageable in an account context only.
    Account,
    /// `account_only: :root` — the root account only.
    Root,
    /// `account_only: :site_admin` — site admins only.
    SiteAdmin,
}

/// Whether Canvas gates the permission on an account setting or feature.
///
/// Canvas's `account_allows` is a lambda over the account, e.g.
/// `a.root_account.feature_enabled?(:horizon_bulk_api_permission)`. The port
/// does not carry Canvas's feature flags, so the layer denies these
/// permissions rather than allowing what Canvas may deny.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AccountAllows {
    /// No account-level condition; the role rules decide.
    Always,
    /// Canvas gates the permission on an account setting or feature flag.
    Required,
}

/// One permission, with the rules that decide who holds it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct PermissionSpec {
    /// The permission name, as Canvas names it.
    pub name: &'static str,
    /// The human label Canvas shows for it.
    pub label: &'static str,
    /// The roles that hold the permission by default.
    pub true_for: &'static [RoleKind],
    /// The roles that never hold the permission.
    pub false_for: &'static [RoleKind],
    /// The roles whose permission value may be overridden. A role that is
    /// not listed is *locked* to the default (Canvas
    /// `RoleOverride#uncached_permission_for`).
    pub available_to: &'static [RoleKind],
    /// Where the permission may be administered.
    pub account_only: AccountOnly,
    /// Whether the permission survives a concluded enrollment.
    pub applies_to_concluded: Concluded,
    /// Whether Canvas gates the permission on an account setting.
    pub account_allows: AccountAllows,
    /// Whether a future (invited) enrollment is denied the permission.
    pub restrict_future_enrollments: bool,
    /// Whether the permission may be used while masquerading.
    pub not_for_masquerading: bool,
    /// Whether Canvas marks the permission as deprecated.
    pub deprecated: bool,
}

/// Every permission Canvas declares, in registry order.
pub static PERMISSIONS: &[PermissionSpec] = &[
